text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both grinding higher with modest overnight gains, but the broader mood remains cautious—the Fear & Greed index sits at 30 and has deteriorated over the past week, signaling skepticism despite price stability. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.2% suggests traders are rotating into altcoins for potential upside, though the relatively light 24-hour volume of $79B indicates conviction is thin across the board. The pattern reads as a market in holding pattern: prices aren't falling, but fear isn't receding either.
